notes_for_editor: Thin history. The NHLR entry is the substantive source: it gives the 80-foot height, the standing-since-1935 date, the Indian Mound location, the USFWS administration and the 2014 nomination by Brian Pippin, but no build date, builder, staffing or fire history. The Forest Lookouts page has little more than a header. The OpenStreetMap node gives height 25 (units assumed metres) and ele 2; facts height_m 24.4 is the NHLR's 80 ft converted, and the OSM tag is not used as a fact. The refuge fact comes from the FWS page (refuge establishment, 1931) and is not tied to the tower in any source. The Friends of St. Marks history timeline has no entry for the tower. The floridamemory.com item on a St. Marks refuge fire tower was not readable (HTTP 403). Access, visit and staffing unknown and left out of facts. The NHLR photo is credited to Brian Pippin; no photo entry added. Two web searches and about six page reads were used. Fact-check 2026-10-08: story now says registered (NHLR 'Date Registered', not accepted) and describes the Forest Lookouts page as carrying little more than a header.
